digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge CLI and reconciliation engine
propositions: Bridge preview and sync must become the primary CLI vocabulary while legacy reconcile, direct-engine --mode, Python library reconcile(), and MCP reconcile() entrypoints remain callable with unchanged defaults and filtering semantics
Canonical --only/--except selection must narrow differ inputs before examination; legacy --filter-local-ids must retain post-differ write filtering without breaking existing callers
Invalid, unresolvable, or disappeared selection tokens must exit 2 before lock acquisition, without invoking differ, applier, manifest, or persistence seams
Capped live sync with --max-changes N must produce deterministic applied/deferred manifests for explicit positive integers; uncapped live and legacy bootstrap behavior remain unchanged
Legacy reconcile-check must remain a lock-free diagnostic path in production workflow distinct from dry-run preview mapping; all other modes must normalize into the canonical preview/sync core
ADR 0092 must document the expand-contract adapter decision, collision-proof reservation, and compatibility rationale; older workflows and environments using legacy vocabulary must remain shippable
